scope: Release-frame skip identity and SVG worker completion identity, state/queue regression checks
changes: Compare the entire presentation Viewport before consuming the one-time redundant release draw skip.
Reject stale worker completion before installing pixels or reporting errors, preserving the newer pending job.
cases: Same document/revision/canvas and viewport consumes reuse exactly once.
Changed document, revision or canvas rejects and consumes reuse.
200% -> 50%, pan in either axis, size, scale, document dimensions, dark mode, pasteboard and canvas colors reject reuse.
Document-coordinate worker result remains valid across view-only changes.
Obsolete completion preserves the newer pending job.
Current completion clears its pending job.
Different window job is not cancelled and remains ahead of the newest same-window job.
Complete release-frame retention ends only when the matching display is ready.
limitations: Queue dequeue models an in-flight job; tests do not execute raster work on another thread or inspect rendered pixels.
No new Release GUI race capture or paired input-latency measurement in this record.
The complete-frame hold while the worker is pending remains independent from the one-time redundant-draw skip.
Physical input-to-photon delay and other operating systems are not tested.
